input.summary: Extend Base Components licence to Customer Affiliates and Subcontractors, remove "revocable", and confirm irrevocability during term plus successor transfer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to Subcontractors acting on our behalf, deleted "revocable" so the licence cannot be pulled at will, and confirmed it runs for the term (subject only to termination for uncured material breach under Section 3.3) and passes to a successor under a permitted assignment. Our licence position does not accept a discretionary revocation right or a grant that excludes the affiliates and contractors who actually use the Services; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates, and its Subcontractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement. Such license is irrevocable during the term of this Agreement, except that IBM may revoke it upon termination of this Agreement for Customer's material breach that remains uncured in accordance with Section 3.3, and is transferable to a successor organization in connection with an assignment permitted under Section 14.10.
